item_name: Potential Indicators of Psychosis — None of the above

lookback_source.quote: Check E0100Z, none of the above: if no hallucinations or delusions were present in the last 7 days.

lookback_notes: The item's own pages state a 7-day look-back period for E0100 ("Review the resident's medical record for the 7-day look-back period") and code E0100Z is based on the last 7 days. Per the general convention, a 7-day observation period consists of the ARD plus the 6 previous calendar days (rai-manual-v1.20.1, p. 2-21).

federal_coding_rules.rule: E0100 is a "check all that apply" item; check E0100Z (none of the above) if no hallucinations or delusions were present in the last 7 days.

source.quote: Code based on behaviors observed and/or thoughts expressed in the last 7 days rather than the presence of a medical diagnosis. Check all that apply.

federal_coding_rules.rule: Code based on behaviors observed and/or thoughts expressed in the last 7 days rather than the presence of a medical diagnosis.

source.quote: Code based on behaviors observed and/or thoughts expressed in the last 7 days rather than the presence of a medical diagnosis.

federal_coding_rules.rule: If a belief cannot be objectively shown to be false, or it is not possible to determine whether it is false, do not code it as a delusion (and therefore it does not count toward checking E0100B, supporting E0100Z when no other indicators are present).

source.quote: If a belief cannot be objectively shown to be false, or it is not possible to determine whether it is false, do not code it as a delusion.

federal_coding_rules.rule: If a resident expresses a false belief but easily accepts a reasonable alternative explanation, do not code it as a delusion; if the resident continues to insist the belief is correct despite an explanation or direct evidence to the contrary, code as a delusion.

source.quote: If a resident expresses a false belief but easily accepts a reasonable alternative explanation, do not code it as a delusion. If the resident continues to insist that the belief is correct despite an explanation or direct evidence to the contrary, code as a delusion.

federal_coding_rules.rule: Resident intent must not be taken into account when coding items in Section E; the section focuses on the resident's actions, not the intent of their behavior.

source.quote: Resident intent should not be taken into account when coding for items in this section.

federal_coding_rules.rule: Example: a resident who misinterprets a real external sound and accepts the alternative explanation is not delusional — E0100Z would be checked.
Example: a false belief readily altered with a simple reminder (attributable to memory loss rather than psychosis) is not a delusion — E0100Z would be checked.

federal.criterion: Review of the resident's medical record for the 7-day look-back period.

source.quote: Review the resident's medical record for the 7-day look-back period.

federal.notes: Listed as Step 1 in Steps for Assessment.

federal.criterion: Interviews with staff members and others who have had the opportunity to observe the resident in a variety of situations during the 7-day look-back period.

source.quote: Interview staff members and others who have had the opportunity to observe the resident in a variety of situations during the 7-day look-back period.

federal.criterion: Observation of the resident during conversations and structured interviews in other assessment sections, listening for statements indicating hallucinations or expression of false beliefs.

source.quote: Observe the resident during conversations and the structured interviews in other assessment sections and listen for statements indicating an experience of hallucinations, or the expression of false beliefs (delusions).

federal.criterion: Clarification/verification of potentially false beliefs, including attempting to verify facts and determining whether a false belief is readily corrected by a simple explanation of verifiable facts.
federal.notes: Step 4 in Steps for Assessment; supports a determination that no delusion was present.

case_mix_relevance.notes: The supplied pages do not tie E0100Z to any payment or case-mix classification.
